entries.diagnoseHint: Checks every hop from the phone to the internet
entries.needsPlugin: Install the RouteLink plugin to see this

advice.move-closer: The signal is weak: try moving the phone closer to the access point
advice.optimize-channel: Run channel optimisation to move off a crowded channel
advice.check-ap-cable: Check the cable or wireless backhaul between the access point and the gateway
advice.check-modem: Check the modem and the dial-up account
advice.isp-unstable: The connection has been unstable lately; it may be your provider
advice.isp-upstream: Heavy loss on the provider's side; it may be your provider
advice.change-dns: The internet is reachable but names don't resolve: try another DNS server
advice.outage-log: See the outage log, useful as evidence for your provider
advice.fix-security: Fix the Wi-Fi security issues in the security check

diagnose.title: One-tap diagnosis
diagnose.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} checked, about 15 seconds in all
diagnose.footer: Checks from near to far. The router-side commands are the same as the diagnostic tools and need no plugin; “Recent stability” needs the plugin.

facts.signal: Signal at the access point {{dbm}} dBm
facts.phoneUnknown: This phone is not in the device list; it may not be on this network's Wi-Fi
facts.rtt: Round trip to the router {{ms}} ms, jitter {{jitter}} ms
facts.rttFail: The phone cannot reach the router
facts.noAps: No reachable access points in the network group
facts.noNexthop: The WAN's next hop is unknown
facts.noProbeData: The plugin returned no latency data
facts.noWifi: Could not read the Wi-Fi settings

tools.title: Diagnostic tools
tools.targetPlaceholder: Host name or IP, e.g. www.apple.com
tools.targetInvalid: Enter a host name or an IP address
tools.serverPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the router's own DNS
tools.footer: Runs with the permission LuCI's diagnostics page already has, so no plugin is needed. At most 60 seconds.

error.REFUSED: The DNS server refused the query

latency.title: Outages and latency
latency.noData: No probe data for this period
latency.chartHint: Press and hold the chart to read a moment
latency.hoursIgnored: Outages and latency cannot be filtered by hours of the day; showing whole days.
latency.footer: The plugin pings every target every 10 seconds; no reply within 2 seconds counts as loss. It is an outage when every target except the WAN's next hop is unreachable.

notEnabled.title: Latency probes are off
notEnabled.message: Turn on latency probes in the plugin settings and recording starts here.

tooOld.title: The plugin is too old
tooOld.message: Upgrade the RouteLink plugin to record outages and latency.

speed.title: Speed test

modeHint.phone: Measured by the phone: Wi-Fi plus broadband.
modeHint.router: Measured by the plugin on the router: the broadband alone.
modeHint.compare: The phone first, then the router: is the bottleneck the Wi-Fi or the broadband?

speed.wanNote: The router's rate comes from the WAN counters, so other devices' traffic at the same time counts too.
speed.notWifi: The phone is not on Wi-Fi: the phone test runs over mobile data.
speed.already: The router is already testing; following that run
speed.needsPlugin: The router test needs the RouteLink plugin
speed.demoNote: Demo mode: the phone test is simulated and uses no data.

compare.title: Verdict
compare.wifi-bottleneck: The phone reached only {{pct}}% of the router: the Wi-Fi is the bottleneck.
compare.broadband: Both are below 60% of your plan: the broadband is the problem.
compare.ok: Neither the Wi-Fi nor the broadband shows a problem.
compare.incomplete: One of the tests did not finish, so there is nothing to compare.
compare.noContract: Enter your plan's bandwidth to also check the broadband against it.

contract.title: Plan bandwidth
contract.footer: Optional. With it, the comparison checks whether the broadband reaches 60% of your plan.

server.title: Test server
server.invalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
server.footerPlugin: Stored in the plugin's settings; the phone and the router both use it.
server.footerNoPlugin: With the RouteLink plugin you can use your own LibreSpeed server instead.
